build_BaseMamba_model: build a BaseMamba model using BaseMambaArgs to configure dim, n_layers, n_heads, and state_dim parameters
create_SSM_module: create an SSM module with configurable hidden_dim, n_heads, state_dim, conv_size, and chunk_size for selective state space modeling
create_MambaBlock_layer: create a MambaBlock layer with RMSNorm and SSM that applies residual connections for sequence transformation
run_SSM_forward: run the SSM forward pass with tensor input, tok_idx, cu_seqlens, and ssm_impl mode for training or generation
init_BaseMamba_weights: initialize BaseMamba model weights using init_weights with depth-based scaling factors and trunc normal initialization
